name: word_count
prompt:
Explain what this Renyi program does in at most three sentences, for a reader who will decide whether to use it. Do not quote code.

module word_count
  purpose: Count how often each word appears in a text file and show the ten most common.

import std.console
import std.environment
import std.filesystem exposing Path, FileError

public type WordCount
  purpose: A word and the number of times it occurred.
  has word: Text
  has occurrences: Integer
  can Compare by occurrences
end

public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words be
    for each line in text.lines(), raw_word in line.split(" ")
    where raw_word.trim() is not ""
    collect raw_word.trim().to_lower()
  let grouped be for each word in words group by word
  return
    for each word, repeats in grouped
    sorted by repeats.length() descending
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: repeats.length())
end

public function main() or fails with FileError needs console, environment, filesystem.read
  purpose: Read the file named on the command line and print its top ten words.

  let path_text be environment.arguments().first() otherwise "data/sample.txt"
  let text be filesystem.read_text(Path(path_text)) otherwise fail
  for each entry in count_words(text).take(10)
    console.print("{entry.occurrences.to_text().pad_left(6)}  {entry.word}")
  end
end
